      <h1 class="talk-title">AI at Work: Practical Data Insights, Privacy and Human Judgement</h1>
    </header>

    <!-- Body Section -->
    <div class="talk-body">

      <!-- Main Description -->
      <section class="talk-description">
        <p>In this six-minute talk, Priya will share practical examples of how AI supports her day-to-day work in data analysis, from cleaning and exploring data to building dashboards and generating insights for business decisions. She will also discuss how AI is used within a protected environment to maintain data privacy and security, while keeping human judgement at the centre of decision-making. The key takeaway: AI is not just a buzzword - it can be a practical, responsible tool for working more efficiently and turning data into meaningful insights.</p>

          </h2>
          <div class="speaker-bio">
            <p>Priya Dingorkar is a Senior Analyst at National Australia Bank (NAB), with a background in data analytics, data science, business analytics, machine learning, statistical modelling, forecasting, and data visualisation. She holds an undergraduate degree in Computer Engineering and a Master of Business Analytics from Monash University, bringing together strong technical, analytical, and business expertise. Priya uses data and AI to solve real-world business challenges, uncover meaningful insights, improve efficiency, and support better decision-making.</p>
